claim_text: A thriving workforce that is safe, healthy, gender balanced at every level, culturally diverse and inclusive and skilled for the future.
metric_name: Engagement and Perception Survey wellbeing score; Female employee representation; Fatalities at managed operations
context_text: A thriving workforce that is safe, healthy, gender balanced at every level, culturally diverse and inclusive and skilled for the future.；88% Engagement and Perception Survey wellbeing score.；41.3% Female employee representation.；1 fatality at managed operations. (2024: 5 fatalities).
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 报告提供了wellbeing和女性占比等相关数据，但未能证明“gender balanced at every level”，且FY2025仍有1起死亡事故，因此只能部分支撑，存在宽泛表述的漂绿嫌疑。
notes: 证据合并自social value scorecard与安全目标绩效页。
